title: Sales Tax Carried on an Instant Exchange Hold
content:
The sales tax carried on a Returns & Exchanges Instant Exchange hold follows the ship-to state of the Online Orders order and the merchandise class of the exchanged line. Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Minnesota exempt clothing and footwear from sales tax.

## Tax on the hold

| Ship-to state | Class of the exchanged line | Tax on the hold |
|---|---|---|
| Pennsylvania, New Jersey or Minnesota | Footwear or apparel | None |
| Pennsylvania, New Jersey or Minnesota | Accessories | The replacement value times the order's sales tax rate on its accessories and their shipping share: the order's sales tax divided by the accessories plus the shipping fee times the accessories' share of the net merchandise at placement |
| Any other state | Any class | The order's sales tax times the replacement value divided by the order's net merchandise at placement |

- **Accessories:** the booked amount of the order's accessories lines. **Net merchandise at placement:** the merchandise subtotal less the discount total.
- The tax is worked out on the replacement value of the units authorized on the exchange.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

- **New Jersey, a coat:** no tax on the hold.
- **Minnesota, a wallet with replacement value 40.00:** accessories 40.00, net merchandise 140.00, shipping fee 7.00, sales tax 2.60. The fee's accessories share is 7.00 times 40.00 divided by 140.00, that is 2.00; the tax is 40.00 times 2.60 divided by 42.00, that is 2.4761…
- **Illinois, trainers with replacement value 89.00:** sales tax 12.00, net merchandise 150.00; the tax is 7.12.
